metas.description: Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
metas.description: קבוצה של אימהות צעירות ודינמיות מאורנג' קאונטי מעוררת סערה בקהילה שבה האמונה היא הזהות עצמה. חלקן נלחמות לשמר את המסורת, אחרות מאמצות את המודרנה ויוצאות לזעזע את המוסכמות. סודות ייחשפו, חזותות יתנפצו וחברויות יועמדו למבחן כשקבוצת המשפיעניות פורצות הדרך הזאת מתאחדת כדי ליצור את התשובה שלהן ל-#MomTok.

metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: The One About Matthew Perry
metas.description: Through personal accounts from family and friends, this documentary unveils the real Matthew Perry, generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life, and his struggles to become the man behind the icon.

metas.name: The Mob
metas.description: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

metas.name: Inside the Circle
metas.description: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

metas.name: Africa Earth's Wild Home
metas.description: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

metas.name: Outside
metas.description: Internet icons the Sidemen drop content creators into the great outdoors to battle through challenges, temptations and scheming for a share of £1 million.

metas.name: The Real Rooneys
metas.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: A double homicide in Kansas gains national attention, spanning over two decades with the involvement of two tenacious citizen sleuths.

metas.name: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
metas.description: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower.

metas.name: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
metas.description: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

metas.name: All the Truth in My Lies
metas.description: Coco and Marín travel in campers to celebrate Blanca's bachelorette party. What was supposed to be an adventure turns into a time bomb when a few secrets between them come to light.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: Follows Mica Miller's life and death. Wife of pastor John-Paul Miller. Features new footage, family interviews, allegations of control, circumstances of her mysterious death, ongoing search for answers.

metas.name: 9/11: Reunited
metas.description: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

metas.name: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
metas.description: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

metas.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
metas.description: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

metas.name: Mourinho
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at José Mourinho's legendary career and ascent to becoming one of soccer's most celebrated and controversial coaches at the highest levels of the sport.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Follow true crime influencer Kara Chamberlain as she investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases that have stumped law enforcement and haunted internet sleuths for decades.

metas.name: The Bombing of Pan Am 103
metas.description: Based on the events surrounding the 1988 Lockerbie bombing. Lockerbie will focus on the investigation into the crash on both sides of the Atlantic and the devastating effect it had on the small town and the families who lost loved...

metas.name: The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
metas.description: Chronicles one of the most chilling murder cases in recent memory — honoring the four young lives that were taken while tracing every step from the night of the killings to the eventual arrest of a suspect.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

metas.name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro
metas.description: Follows 12 up-and-coming dancers who move into one house and compete in a grueling audition process for a coveted pro dancer slot on Dancing with the Stars Season 35.

metas.name: The Apartment Job
metas.description: Depicts the story of former gangster Hae Gang, who runs for apartment residents' association president to get his hands on the building's hidden money, only to unintentionally uncover corruption within the complex.

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: Amadeus
metas.description: A 25-year-old Amadeus arrives in Vienna, unemployed. He allies with singer Constanze Weber, who helps bring him into the orbit of court composer Salieri, igniting a rivalry that defines their legacies.

metas.name: Lord of the Flies
metas.description: A plane crash strands a group of British boys on an unoccupied tropical island, where they gradually slide into anarchy as social conventions disappear and attempts at responsible rule divide them into warring factions.

metas.name: The Grand-ish Tour
metas.description: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

metas.name: The House of the Spirits
metas.description: Spanning a century, the Trueba family faces secret loves, revolution, and generational conflict between the tyrannical patriarch and his granddaughter, set against violent social upheaval.

metas.name: Should I Marry a Murderer?
metas.description: A fiancée becomes a key witness after staying engaged to a man accused of murder to gather evidence against him in this documentary series.

metas.name: Unconditional
metas.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

metas.name: My Brother the Minotaur
metas.description: When a minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure—with help from his brother and friends—to understand who he really is.

metas.name: Naughty Business
metas.description: A conservative housewife has to confront her beliefs when her husband falls into a coma, leaving her in charge of their video store on the brink of bankruptcy. She specializes in selling adult films, causing uproar in the neighbor...

metas.name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
metas.description: Terry Bollea became Hulk Hogan. This unfiltered documentary reveals the man behind the legend through his final interview.

metas.name: Funny AF with Kevin Hart
metas.description: Kevin Hart travels the country with the help of comedy legends to find the next stand-up superstar — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.

metas.name: Dandelion
metas.description: At an afterlife agency where angels guide lingering souls, Tetsuo and Misaki take on any challenge to help the dead find peace in their own offbeat style.

metas.name: Bandi
metas.description: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

metas.name: Trust Me: The False Prophet
metas.description: A cult expert and her videographer husband embed themselves in a vulnerable FLDS community, where they discover disturbing evidence about Samuel Bateman, who claims to be the successor to imprisoned prophet Warren Jeffs.

metas.name: Sins of Kujo
metas.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

metas.name: Secrets of the Bees
metas.description: With the expertise of entomologist and fellow National Geographic Explorer Dr. Samuel Ramsey, the series uses groundbreaking filming technology to reveal the extraordinary world of bees; and uncover their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets and featuring never-before-filmed moments.

metas.name: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
metas.description: A certain atmosphere of horror is felt the week before the celebration of an unfortunate wedding.

metas.name: Love Overboard
metas.description: Step aboard the ultimate luxury yacht, where sexy singles are ready to mix and mingle ... and find love. But there's a twist ... gaining access to the yacht's extravagant amenities won't be so simple. As the journey unfolds, romance ignites; alliances form; and hearts are shattered. In the end, only one couple will reign supreme. Who will rise to the top, and who will be left stranded?

metas.name: Lucky Luke
metas.description: Lucky Luke must help Louise find her mother, who mysteriously disappeared, while foiling a plot that could change the course of American history.

metas.name: The Dark Wizard
metas.description: Dean Potter, the groundbreaking yet divisive climber, base jumper and highline walker, accomplishes stunning feats while confronting his personal struggles.

metas.name: Dynasty: The Murdochs
metas.description: Offers an unprecedented look at one the world’s most powerful families at a crossroads, as its patriarch, Rupert Murdoch, makes one last play to ensure his legacy at all costs.

metas.name: Twisted Yoga
metas.description: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they'd joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.

metas.name: The TikTok Killer
metas.description: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

metas.name: DTF St. Louis
metas.description: A darkly comedic tale of three middle-aged individuals entangled in a love triangle, leading to one's untimely demise.

metas.name: Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai
metas.description: Baki and the strongest Underground Arena fighters face a threat of historical proportions: the resurrected Musashi Miyamoto, Japan's greatest samurai.

metas.name: Strip Law
metas.description: Uptight lawyer Lincoln Gumb, who is too boring to win cases in Vegas, teams up with local magician/hedonist Sheila Flambé to bring some flash and pizzazz to the stupidest cases the city can throw at them.

metas.name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman
metas.description: When convicted double murderer Sarah Pender escapes from a maximum-security prison in Indiana, a nationwide manhunt is immediately launched. Charged alongside her former boyfriend, who pled guilty, for the murder of a young couple, Pender has vanished, igniting fear, fascination, and a relentless pursuit that stretches across state lines.

metas.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
metas.description: Follows Gordon Ramsay's journey to launch dining concepts at 22 Bishopsgate, London's second tallest building..

metas.name: How to Get to Heaven from Belfast
metas.description: Three lifelong friends reunite after the death of an old classmate turns a wake into a dark mystery. They embark on a thrilling adventure across Ireland, piecing together enigmatic truths amid complicated lives.

metas.name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
metas.description: When high school student Cassie Stoddart is found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community is gripped by fear that a random killer is on the loose. Police retrace Cassie's final hours and focus on three classmates that were the last people to see her alive. As the investigation narrows, detectives uncover a shocking buried video tape that reframes the case, raising the unthinkable question of whether 16-year-olds could have committed such a brutal crime.

metas.name: Cash Queens
metas.description: When life pushes them to the brink, five desperate friends decide the only way out is to form a gang, swipe some guns and start holding up banks.

metas.name: Vanished
metas.description: Alice Monroe's romantic French vacation becomes a dangerous mystery when boyfriend Tom Parker vanishes from a train to Arles, forcing her to uncover hidden truths about his past.

metas.name: Take That
metas.description: The story of one of the greatest boy bands in UK history. For more than 30 years, they have brought us hit after hit, 12 of which became UK number ones.

metas.name: The Beauty
metas.description: Partners Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett investigate "the Beauty" STD causing aesthetic effects but proving lethal, evading corrupt officials and a mercenary targeting them amidst a suspected government conspiracy.

metas.name: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
metas.description: In 1925, a country house party prank turns deadly. Lady Eileen "Bundle" Brent investigates the chilling murder plot. Lady Caterham and Superintendent Battle assist in solving the country house mystery that changes Bundle's life.

metas.name: Ponies
metas.description: In 1970s Moscow, two secretaries at the American embassy become CIA operatives after their husbands are killed, uncovering a Cold War conspiracy behind the tragedy.

metas.name: Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV
metas.description: A look back at the rise, fall and lasting impact of the most sensational era in TV talk show history. By exploring the psychological forces that shaped the talk TV genre, the series reveals how these shows transformed from trusted confessional spaces into lightning rods of controversy, leaving a lasting impact on culture, media and the people caught in the chaos.

metas.name: Coldwater
metas.description: John moves his family to a rural town, befriends enigmatic neighbor Tommy hiding dark secrets. John's fascination with Tommy grows as wife Fiona becomes suspicious, leading to dangerous unraveling of hidden truths and repressed an...

metas.name: His & Hers
metas.description: A journalist investigating a murder in her hometown clashes with a suspicious detective. There are two sides to every story, and someone is lying.

metas.name: Run Away
metas.description: Simon's perfect life is shattered when daughter Paige runs away, later found strung out in a park. Simon's search leads into a dangerous underworld where an act of violence rocks his life.

metas.name: Members Only: Palm Beach
metas.description: Within the exclusive enclaves of Palm Beach County, follow a group of women navigating the unspoken rules, inherited traditions and high-stakes hierarchies of America's most rarefied social circles. In this manicured world of privilege and private clubs, reputations are built over brunch, alliances shift over champagne, and while wealth is ubiquitous, power, influence and access are the true currency.

metas.name: Born to Be Wild
metas.description: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.

metas.name: Taylor Swift: The End of an Era
metas.description: Taylor Swift's concert film captures the magic of her record-breaking tour, featuring backstage moments and special performances with fellow artists, while sharing personal insights from her closest circle.

metas.name: The Revenge Club
metas.description: Six divorce support group members shift from seeking healing to plotting revenge. Their shared pain creates an unexpected alliance, turning therapeutic meetings into something more sinister.

metas.name: Simon Cowell: The Next Act
metas.description: Simon Cowell is looking for the next hit boy band. And he's risking it all to find them. Will these young singers prove he's still got the Midas touch?

metas.name: The Price of Confession
metas.description: A woman accused of killing her husband is offered a deal by a mysterious stranger - but to prove her innocence, she must commit murder.

metas.name: The Twelve Dates 'Til Christmas
metas.description: Follows Kate, a textile pattern designer living in Blexford, England, who lives next door to her father Mac. Kate spends much of her time caring for Mac, who is recovering from a motorcycle accident and rarely leaves his recliner.

metas.name: The Abandons
metas.description: When a corrupt force of wealth and power covets the lands of a group of diverse and atypical families and tries to drive them out, they must pursue their Manifest Destiny.

metas.name: Sean Combs: The Reckoning
metas.description: A revealing look at Sean Combs' journey from music mogul to controversial figure, featuring footage and insider accounts that expose both his groundbreaking success with Bad Boy Entertainment and the troubling shadows behind his e...

metas.name: The Death of Bunny Munro
metas.description: A look at the life of a sex-addict traveling salesman who uses his door-to-door beauty products to meet women.

metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: Author Aggie Wiggs, grieving the loss of her son, finds new purpose unraveling the mystery behind neighbor Nile Jarvis' vanished wife and his suspicious dealings.

metas.name: Had I Not Seen the Sun
metas.description: Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

metas.name: Dynamite Kiss
metas.description: A single woman who disguises herself as a married mom to get a job, and the team leader of a baby products company who falls in love with her.

metas.name: Mrs Playmen
metas.description: Betrayed by her husband, a woman must step up and run an erotic magazine that becomes a symbol of empowerment in '70s Rome. Inspired by true events.

metas.name: Caroline Flack: Search for the Truth
metas.description: Follow Caroline's mother, Christine, as she investigates the truth about her daughter's final months - uncovering new shocking details, asking difficult questions, and exposing the misrepresentations, pressures, and failures from institutions and decision makers that shaped Caroline's final days.

metas.name: MARINES
metas.description: Follow the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit as they conduct high-stakes combat exercises in the Pacific.

metas.name: BAT-FAM
metas.description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

metas.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
metas.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: When her son vanishes after a play date at the park, a mother is thrust into a desperate search to uncover the truth behind his disappearance.

metas.name: Death by Lightning
metas.description: Dramatizes the stranger-than-fiction true story of 20th U.S. President James Garfield, and admirer Charles Guiteau, who assassinated him.

metas.name: The Bad Guys: The Series
metas.description: How did the Bad Guys break into the bad guy business in the first place? Find out in this hilarious prequel series set before the hit films.

metas.name: All's Fair
metas.description: Follows a successful divorce lawyer and the owner of an all-female law firm in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Tell Me Your Name
metas.description: Toledo, Spain, 1997. The residents of Río Blanco have accepted the settlement of Moroccan seasonal workers in Fuensanta. Coexistence brings tensions, known by Sonia, an NGO leader; Father Ángel, the local priest; and Safir, the imam. What they don't imagine is that Fuensanta's foundations hide something capable of unleashing their worst nightmares, regardless of their beliefs or prayers.

metas.name: Son of a Donkey
metas.description: Theo comes up with chaotic schemes to save his impounded car. Meanwhile, his dying dad will stop at nothing to find himself a new kidney.

metas.name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
metas.description: Lost in a dark fairy tale realm, Yu enrolls at a magical academy where ghosts roam freely and students battle for supremacy in an upcoming supernatural competition.

metas.name: Lazarus
metas.description: After experiencing a personal loss, Lazarus begins having disturbing experiences that can't be explained.

metas.name: The Monster of Florence
metas.description: As a serial killer strikes terror in Italy by targeting couples parked in lovers lanes, authorities explore a case from 1968 that may be key to identifying The Monster of Florence.

metas.name: Mob War: Philadelphia vs. The Mafia
metas.description: Philadelphia is the City of Brotherly Love, but in the '90s, it was a bloodbath. Two warring mob factions battle for control in this true-crime series.

metas.name: The Guest
metas.description: A cleaner becomes captivated by her wealthy employer's charismatic influence. As their intense friendship grows and secrets emerge, their relationship spirals into a dangerous psychological game where nothing is quite what it seems.

metas.name: Mr. Scorsese
metas.description: Follows the life and career of legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese.
